text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 轻悬疑 · 海边档案室 · 纯环境.
Environment: An empty old coastal town archive reading room, pale gray filing drawers, warm oak map table with one blank folded chart and closed folder, frosted tall windows, distant cloudy sea visible through clear upper panes. Overcast daylight fills the room beautifully; a quiet unanswered-story atmosphere conveyed through composition, no horror darkness, no evidence photos or portraits. Original cinematic location photography for an intimate romance story. Vicky's aesthetic: bright high-key but retained highlight texture; cream white, pale gray, warm natural brown with restrained muted accent color; soft broad frontal/window fill, gentle low-contrast shadows; tactile plaster, wood, linen, glass and stone; very subtle film halation and grain, clean luminous air. Lived-in details without clutter, beautiful but plausible real location rather than showroom CGI. 35-50mm natural perspective, midground environment clearly legible with gently softer far depth. Strictly environment only: absolutely no people, bodies, faces, hands, silhouettes, distant pedestrians, reflections of people, animals, birds, fish, pets, mannequins, humanoid statues, character artwork or human figures on screens. No watermark, branding or captions. Keep clear usable space for later character compositing. Natural proportions, believable architecture, no fisheye, no excessive HDR, no greasy shine, no orange color cast.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Use case: spatial production design. Create 三维图 for 轻悬疑 · 海边档案室 · 纯环境. Image 1 is the geometric source of truth. Image 2 is original material and style reference. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. Keep the plan footprint, doors, windows, fixed landmarks and circulation exactly consistent. Concept reconstruction, not measured construction. Match original color palette and rendering style, detailed legible clean image, landscape. NO people, animals, silhouettes or figures on posters. No fake measurements, no watermarks.
